description: This file defines extension methods for configuring and adding streaming support to Orleans silos and clients. It mainly registers various streaming-related services into the dependency injection container, such as runtime implementations, subscription managers, namespace providers, and stream filters.

classes.name: StreamingServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure streaming services for Orleans silos and clients.

methods.name: AddSiloStreaming
methods.description: Configures and registers services required for silo streaming support in Orleans.

methods.name: AddClientStreaming
methods.description: Configures and registers services required for client streaming support in Orleans.

methods.name: AddStreamFilter
methods.description: Registers a stream filter of a specified type and name.
